reading.title: Mars-Jupiter Conjunction under Scorpio Sun
overview: The Sun stands at 23° Scorpio with Mercury at 5° Scorpio. The Moon at 5° Aquarius is not void and next squares Mercury. Venus stations retrograde at 23° Libra. Mars at 26° Leo conjoins Jupiter at the same degree while the Sun squares both. Saturn retrogrades at 8° Aries in fall, Uranus retrogrades at 4° Gemini, Neptune retrogrades at 2° Aries, and Pluto at 3° Aquarius is out of bounds. The North Node sits at 25° Aquarius.

Mundane tradition reads the Mars-Jupiter conjunction as expansionist pressure and risk of overreach, the Sun squares as leaders inclined to confrontation, and Venus station as diplomatic or financial reversals. The recent Scorpio new moon at 17° places emphasis on hidden matters or shared resources according to whole-sign houses from each capital. Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto point to gradual shifts in power structures and collective assumptions.

Transits to national angles include Neptune opposing the US MC, Neptune squaring Russia's Sun, Pluto conjoining China's Moon and ASC, and Mars squaring Iran's MC. The next lunation cycle and upcoming stations of Saturn direct, Jupiter retrograde, and Neptune direct mark the period ahead.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Jupiter and Mars oppose the Moon and Saturn sextiles Uranus. These contacts coincide with reports of Iranian drone activity near US forces in the Gulf, though the fair-test records show no reliable link between such configurations and measurable escalations.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Uranus squares the Moon while Pluto conjoins Saturn. The pattern aligns with ongoing Ukrainian strikes on rear-area targets, yet records indicate Mars afflictions produce no better than chance correlation with daily personnel-loss claims.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Jupiter conjoins natal Jupiter and Mercury. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction sits with reports of airfield strikes, though the same records find Mars afflictions no better than chance against air-raid data.

Saturn squares the natal Sun and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter. Uranus trine Pluto and related aspects coincide with election-market activity and PLA aircraft data, but eclipse and lunation tests against global events remain at chance levels.

Mars and Jupiter both square the MC while Uranus squares Venus. These contacts appear with tanker and drone reports, yet the compiled records show no predictive edge for Mars configurations over baseline rates.

reading.lore_and_intel: Mars-Jupiter and Sun-square-Mars aspects overlap with Ukraine strike reports and Zelensky statements on energy defense at z-values above 3. Uranus trine Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune overlap with Taiwan election markets and PLA sortie counts at z 3.8-5.5. Mercury square Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto touch tanker and drone stories at z 3.8-4.8. No overlap appears with North Korea or Israel charts in the supplied reporting, and several US-related Neptune contacts show z below 2.0.

watch.note: Sun enters Sagittarius; note any shift in tone of public statements or legislation.
Full Moon at Gemini 2°; observe whether communications or transport issues surface in national charts.
Saturn stations direct; watch for clarification on previously stalled matters involving Saturn-ruled houses.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions produce no better than chance results against Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts, and Russian loss claims. Full moons, new moons, and eclipses likewise test at chance levels for earthquakes and conflict indicators. The data therefore supply no evidence that these configurations predict events above baseline rates.
